exact_result: For every original normal good polarized affine cone over every arbitrary-cardinality algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field and every fixed rational or irrational Reeb xi, the genuine E1/R MA image is precisely the positive Radon probabilities on original K=X_0^T with finite actual H(xi) dual energy, equivalently integrating every actual E1 potential. Solutions are actually attained and unique modulo constants; every normalized actual E1 maximizing sequence satisfies I<=deficit/(2a_p), a_p=p/4^(p+1), p>=1; p=1 gives factor 8, and n=1 is the literal point case. Uses the explicitly established task-granted projective envelope and cone calculus background, with no residual EP or realization condition.
